summary: Choose folders and a battery-friendly sync schedule.
page_description: Keep selected folders in sync while controlling when your Kobo uses Wi-Fi.
release_notes: Rebuild Sync against a Syncthing engine pinned to a digest the build recipe can reproduce.

steps.text: Sync requires a Cobalt platform build containing the pinned ARMv7 Syncthing engine and a package-manager-installed Syncthing binary on your computer.
Pair exactly one local directory to a fixed safe folder while the Kobo is awake on Wi-Fi.
Resume Sync on the Kobo, then start the private host peer. It does not modify another Syncthing installation.
